name: Matala

queries.query: Matala Angola official cadastral parcel map cadastre geoportal land registry
queries.result: Found official Angola IGCA national cadastre authority, the official national property-registration portal, and an official MAT service-points page listing Matala. No anonymous Matala parcel feature service or parcel geometry endpoint was found.

queries.query: Matala Angola cadastro predial mapa de parcelas registo predial geoportal oficial
queries.result: Found official IGCA material describing the national cadastral authority and 2025 pilot, the Inscreva Já property-registration campaign, and MAT's Matala service-point entries. The public portal assets expose authenticated property-registration application routes, not an anonymous parcel layer.

officialSources.operator: Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola (IGCA)
officialSources.evidence: Official IGCA page identifies IGCA as Angola's national cartography and cadastre authority and describes the national geographic-information role. It did not expose a public Matala parcel layer in the retrieved material.

Official 2025 announcement describes the mass property-cadastre pilot and assignment of a Número de Identificação Predial (NIP); it is national programme evidence, not proof of an open Matala geometry service.

Official public campaign portal describes nationwide property registration and map-based self-registration. Its current JavaScript was inspected; property/application API routes are authenticated or application-specific, and no anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.

Official service-points page contains three Matala entries with weekday hours and embedded map views. The entries have placeholder-like contact/location values and do not identify a cadastral layer, native parcel IDs, or an open map API. This is local service/procedure context, not verified local cadastral custody.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: retrieved by official-site search result; direct curl certificate hostname mismatch
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official IGCA content was available through the web index. Direct TLS request was not bypassed because no certificate exception was authorized.
Official announcement was inspected for cadastral programme and NIP evidence; no anonymous geometry endpoint was exposed.

Landing page retrieved with verified TLS. Current runtime.js/main.js assets were retrieved and inspected; no unauthenticated parcel feature query was identified. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or private token was used.

Current JavaScript/configuration inspected. It references authenticated property-registration services and map/application helpers; no safe anonymous Matala parcel schema, CRS, ID response, or geometry was returned.

Official MAT HTML retrieved with verified TLS. Three Matala service entries and Google map embeds were present; embedded basemap views are not cadastral parcel services and were not treated as parcel evidence.
Official Registo Predial page was a discovery lead but did not provide a usable public parcel endpoint.
No exact-point request was made; no absence inference is drawn.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: IGCA is evidenced as Angola's national cartography/cadastre authority; the 2025 pilot describes national cadastral registration and NIP assignment.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National authority and programme context plus MAT Matala service-point entries; no open Matala parcel geometry, schema, CRS, native identity, or citywide coverage was verified.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No point query was run because no public parcel endpoint was identified; this is not evidence of citywide absence.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if later exposed
remainingUncertainty: A non-public or authenticated IGCA/MinFin/MAT cadastral service may exist, and the national pilot may have Matala coverage, but no anonymous public parcel API or safe feature response was found. The MAT page's Matala contact/location fields are incomplete or placeholders.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently inspect the current official IGCA/MinFin cadastral services and confirm whether an anonymous Matala parcel layer, native NIP/parcel ID, CRS, and city coverage are available before adapter qualification.
